title: Snake Classic
description: Eat apples, grow your trail, and survive longer with every turn.
instructions: Use the arrow keys to steer the snake around the board.
Collect apples to increase your score and length.
Avoid crashing into walls or your own tail.

title: Tetris Deluxe
description: Stack falling blocks, clear lines, and chase your best combo streak.
instructions: Move and rotate pieces to fit them into complete horizontal lines.
Clear multiple lines in a row to keep the board under control.
Use the spacebar to hard-drop a piece when you spot the perfect placement.
